treatment.continuity: One white, ink and #2f8cff palette sampled from the screenshot runs throughout. The hook states the goal and names MiniMax Code's Coding and Work modes; it crossfades into the real interface focused on the message input, whose line only says the goal enters the product so no unattributed capability claim sits in the hero. The feature grid carries the real screenshot in each card and is headed 'As MiniMax describes it' so every capability reads as a product claim rather than a measured result. The endcard repeats that attribution beside the exact CTA and URL. Mallet pulse at 96 BPM with auto SFX on landings; no VO and no outcome sting.
